methods.what: Definition of the reduced diffraction variable
Power series for the circular-aperture result (equivalent to the Bessel function J1), given as a mean value of an integrand over φ
Substitution α = 2√θ turning the series into √θ times a power series in θ; the coefficient ratios have denominators 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42
Numerical location of the first zero of fθ by trial values and interpolation (the first dark ring)
Alternative mean-value integral representation of the same series
